summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, reporting results of a Special General Meeting held that day. The sole proposal, as described in an August 17, 2026 proxy statement, was approved by the requisite shareholder majority. The filing does not disclose the proposal's subject matter, terms, or voting percentages. It is a routine post-meeting disclosure required under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are mentioned. The filing is procedural and administrative in nature, merely confirming shareholder approval in accordance with Israeli corporate governance. What to watch: no further action is indicated; this is a standard compliance filing with no special-situation implications.
